notes.title: Demo Update - v0.2.15145
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44621288/d34f46a3979f869ea13b65d96755c86547eee76d.png
Attention, Chrononaut!

We got something for you!

The Chronos Event Demo just got a fresh update, laying the groundwork for the outfit selection system, fixing some bugs and making some changes for the better.

Have a look at what's new on the demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44621288/7f482f36e11a7dc89dd548a59e735df5ad4e948f.png
The Chronos Event Demo - v0.2.15145 Patch Notes

Additions:

 Implemented a new outfits feature (laying groundwork for now)

Changes:

 Higher ceilings throughout most of the levels, allowing for more vertical movement
 Adjusted the first room to no longer prepopulate with enemies, reducing confusion for new players
 Lots of other art and minor gameplay adjustments

Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where players could get stuck behind locked doors when taking specific paths in certain maps
 Resolved an issue where rapidly pressing the upgrade button in the upgrade screen could cause the game to freeze indefinitely
 Removed an experimental game mode that was accidentally accessible via a key press, which prevented players from shooting


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44621288/7f482f36e11a7dc89dd548a59e735df5ad4e948f.png
The Demo - Experience The Chronos Event

In our playable demo, you'll take control of Dr. Alicia De Leon as she navigates through the chaos of the invaded Vanguard Facility. You're hurrying to intervene in a critical attack on ANGIE, the facility's superintelligent AI. The attackers are working to turn ANGIE against the facility and everyone in it, and it's up to you to stop them.

Play The Chronos Event Demo now!
